facts.label: Public billing unit
facts.value: Pricing says USD per user/month, based on an annual subscription; no complete public active-user versus stored-user billing definition found in pricing/billing docs.

facts.label: Published billing implementation
facts.value: Server source reports distinct userIds with stored credentials per application; daily metering sums report.Users across applications sharing a subscription item and sends a set usage value to Stripe.

facts.label: Free hosted allowance
facts.value: Free: up to 10,000 users; one application per developer organization; one console administrator; toolkit, support and docs included.

facts.label: Customer Pro rate and commitment
facts.value: USD $0.05 per user/month for first 10,000 users; $0.01 per user/month above 10,000; pricing based on annual subscription, taxes excluded.

facts.label: Workforce Enterprise rate
facts.value: USD $3 per workforce user/month, based on annual subscription; includes Pro features, app/org logs, advanced support and self-host beta.

facts.label: Pro component formula
facts.value: For a known billable user count U: USD/month equivalent = 0.05×min(U,10,000) + 0.01×max(U−10,000,0), under the public annual-subscription rate card.

facts.label: Other invoicing details
facts.value: Exact aggregation window for changing stored counts, cross-app duplicate-user treatment in the hosted contract, minimum, proration and rounding not publicly defined in checked pricing/billing pages.

facts.label: Business baseline scope
facts.value: Required organization-membership/invitation/roles and app-customer SAML configurations not established; two scenario attempts below retain unknown combined totals.

facts.label: Customer-organization limits/fees
facts.value: Native app-customer memberships, invitations, per-organization roles and organization fees not found in checked docs/pricing/API source.

facts.label: SSO and SCIM fees
facts.value: Public customer SAML/OIDC broker or SCIM-directory fee schedule, included connections and setup charges not found.

facts.label: Builder seats and apps
facts.value: Free: one application/organization and one console administrator. Pro: unlimited apps and console admins. Enterprise includes Pro features.

facts.label: Admin permission model
facts.value: All console administrators have equal rights, including ability for a newly invited admin to remove an older admin.

facts.label: Environments, domains and keys
facts.value: Separate included staging environments, custom-domain allowances and environment-specific pricing not published. Each app gets key pairs; console permits creating more keys.

facts.label: Hosted magic-link sending
facts.value: Built-in /magic-links/send sends a link without requiring the app to configure its own email provider; must enable Magic Links in app settings.

facts.label: Email quotas and age restrictions
facts.value: Source applies rolling 30-day send quota, with reduced quota for young apps; first 24 hours allow only admin email. Exact hosted per-plan base send allowance not published in checked docs.

facts.label: Self-host communication
facts.value: Default self-host email goes to a file; own AWS, SendGrid or SMTP provider can be configured for admin communication and delivery.

facts.label: User cap behavior
facts.value: max_users_exceeded prevents creation of a new user after the plan’s maximum; existing users may still add additional credentials.

facts.label: Email/rate exhaustion
facts.value: Magic-link quota exceeded returns 429; disabled magic links return 403; very new apps restricted to administrator email for 24 hours.

facts.label: Spending/payment controls
facts.value: Current spending caps, payment-failure grace, automatic upgrade and precise user-tier overflow charges not found.

facts.label: Other billable items
facts.value: No separate public per-request, token or credential rate found; logs/attestation/self-host beta are Enterprise gates; exact email quota add-on rate not published.

facts.label: Builder eligibility and countries
facts.value: Complete Passwordless.dev-specific age, country/payment eligibility and company-domain requirements not published in the checked product/setup/billing docs.

facts.label: Self-service entry
facts.value: Free account signup and app creation documented; Free plan is offered for ongoing use, without an expiry stated in the product pricing.

facts.label: Paid/self-host entry limits
facts.value: Paid organization upgrade managed through billing; Enterprise includes self-host beta, which documentation explicitly forbids using in production.

facts.label: Product scope
facts.value: Passkey/WebAuthn developer platform with public client API, private backend API, SDKs and admin console; also supplies optional magic-link token delivery.

facts.label: Deployment editions
facts.value: Vendor-hosted service; Enterprise self-hosting beta via Docker. Customer passkey plans and workforce Enterprise have different pricing.

facts.label: Who operates hosted/self-hosted
facts.value: Hosted credential API/store/admin console operated by vendor; self-host beta operator runs container, persistence, database, TLS/reverse proxy and email configuration.

facts.label: Native primary methods
facts.value: Passkeys/WebAuthn and optional email magic links are documented; step-up can use an existing passkey/security key.

facts.label: Passwords, OTP, phone, guest and wallet methods
facts.value: Native email/password validation, email-code/SMS-code login, managed anonymous accounts and wallet sign-in not established in the checked method docs/API endpoint catalogue.

facts.label: Social login
facts.value: Native Google/Apple/GitHub/Microsoft social OAuth connector catalogue not found.

facts.label: Passkey first-factor and selectors
facts.value: Free toolkit supports discoverable credentials, sign-in by userId/alias, native autofill, platform authenticators and roaming/security-key authenticators.

facts.label: Passkey user verification and attestation
facts.value: Registration userVerification can be preferred (default), required or discouraged; authenticatorType any/platform/cross-platform. Enterprise allows direct/indirect attestation; Free/Pro use none.

facts.label: Domain/platform requirements
facts.value: WebAuthn needs a secure context (HTTPS or localhost); credential retains relying-party ID/origin. iOS/Android require website-app association files.

facts.label: Fallback and lost-device handling
facts.value: App can keep multiple credentials and implement recovery through magic links or privileged generated authentication tokens; complete managed recovery policy not supplied.

facts.label: MFA/step-up primitives
facts.value: Passkey/security-key user verification and stepup purpose available; authentication configurations set per-purpose token TTL and user-verification requirement.

facts.label: Recovery-code/factor suite
facts.value: Managed TOTP/SMS/email-code MFA enrollment and backup-code issue/regenerate/redeem workflow not found.

facts.label: Email verification and identifier changes
facts.value: Magic link can prove access to its delivered address, but caller must verify supplied email corresponds to supplied userId. Aliases are app-managed, not verified email claims.

facts.label: Reset and end-user account lifecycle
facts.value: Native password reset, managed phone verification and ready-made end-user delete-account flow not found; app owns primary user lifecycle.

facts.label: Token lifetimes
facts.value: Registration token default expires after 120 seconds; generated authentication token default 120 seconds with configurable TTL; magic-link token default one hour.

facts.label: Magic-link replay behavior
facts.value: Magic links are reusable until TTL expiry and do not expire on first click.

facts.label: Application sessions and revocation
facts.value: App sets its own cookie/session after signin/verify success; application session TTL, refresh-token policy and lost-device session revocation are outside the documented managed toolkit.

facts.label: Documented standards and federation boundary
facts.value: FIDO2/WebAuthn/CTAP passkey infrastructure is documented; native app-customer SAML/OIDC provider/client/broker configuration not established.

facts.label: Customer membership/role model
facts.value: Native customer workspaces, invitations, app-user role hierarchy and membership authorization not published.

facts.label: SCIM
facts.value: SCIM version, user/group provisioning, directory/deactivation behavior and plan/fee not found in docs or server endpoint catalogue.

facts.label: Login UI supplied
facts.value: Browser/device-native WebAuthn prompts through client SDK; developer builds its registration/sign-in flow; React/ASP.NET examples available.

facts.label: Hosted account/profile screens
facts.value: Vendor-hosted app-user login/profile/member-management suite not found in the documented toolkit.

facts.label: UI branding/domain ownership
facts.value: App owns its login frontend and passkey relying-party domain; self-host beta exposes configurable BWP_DOMAIN and TLS/reverse-proxy setup.

facts.label: Hosted API/domain and mail branding fees
facts.value: Custom hosted API hostname, domain-count allowances, white-label sender/template settings and related fees not published in checked docs/pricing.

facts.label: Localization and accessibility
facts.value: Product-specific translated hosted UI list, WCAG conformance report, VPAT or independent accessibility assessment not found.

facts.label: Web and backend integrations
facts.value: Official JavaScript client; .NET, Java, Node.js, PHP and Python examples; any backend can call the private REST API.

facts.label: Published runtime requirements
facts.value: Node example says ES2018/CommonJS/ES and Node 10+; .NET example uses .NET 7; Python 3 example says 3.8+.

facts.label: Native mobile clients
facts.value: Official Android SDK requires Android 9/API 28+ and Java 8+; iOS SDK requires iOS 16 and associated webcredentials domain; supports native autofill/alias/discoverable/known-user sign-in.

facts.label: Cross-platform/desktop clients
facts.value: Dedicated first-party React Native, Flutter or desktop-native SDK and exact feature/version matrix not found in the published client index.

facts.label: Hosted app prerequisites
facts.value: Own frontend/backend, account database/userId, public API key in client and private secret on server; service stores credential public keys.

facts.label: Self-host dependencies
facts.value: Docker image, persistent /etc/bitwarden_passwordless volume; SQLite default with api.db/admin.db, optional Microsoft SQL Server; optional external email service and TLS/reverse proxy.

facts.label: Self-host lifecycle and deployment
facts.value: Enterprise beta expressly for experimentation/discovery, not production; image stable/specific version/latest tags; latest tracks main; no sync with hosted console or in-place tier upgrade.

facts.label: Operations and health
facts.value: Port 5701 exposed; internal console/API 5000/5001; health checks for process/database/schema/email, with dependency failure returning 503.

facts.label: Sizing, backup and upgrade guarantees
facts.value: Published production hardware sizing, supported restore procedure, RPO/RTO and safe beta upgrade/rollback contract not found.

facts.label: Custom authentication purposes
facts.value: Auth configurations define purpose, TTL, userVerificationRequirement and credential hints; stepup returns proof tagged for the configured purpose.

facts.label: Custom recovery proof
facts.value: Server can mint a manual authentication token after app-specific recovery/identity verification and submit it to the ordinary verification endpoint.

facts.label: Webhooks/hooks/custom code limits
facts.value: Public webhook event-subscription/delivery/retry contract, hosted code hooks and execution quotas not found in documentation/server endpoint catalogue.

facts.label: User and credential administration
facts.value: Console lists application users/credentials/aliases; private API/source exposes users/list, users/count, users/delete and credentials/list/delete.

facts.label: Management limitations and token minting
facts.value: Per-user disable/ban and audited support-impersonation workflow not established; app-level API key locking affects all calls using that key.

facts.label: Credential/alias association
facts.value: Multiple credentials and up to ten unique aliases per userId; aliases ≤250 characters. Updating aliases submits the full replacement array.

facts.label: Cross-account merge and guests
facts.value: Cross-userId merge/unmerge, social-account linking and managed anonymous-to-registered upgrade not found.

facts.label: Passkey and attestation controls
facts.value: Domain/RP-bound WebAuthn challenges, userVerification preference/requirement, platform/roaming selection and Enterprise attestation controls.

facts.label: Magic-link anti-abuse controls
facts.value: Application-age restriction, rolling email quota and per-tenant fixed-window send throttling exist in published source.

facts.label: Other abuse protections
facts.value: Native CAPTCHA, stolen-password screening, SMS-pumping protection, risk-scoring defaults and their pricing not found for this product.

facts.label: Published magic-link request limiter
facts.value: Source /magic-links/send uses a five-minute fixed window, 10 permits per application/tenant, zero queue; rejections return HTTP 429; host override can bypass.

facts.label: Core request capacity
facts.value: Hosted passkey registration/sign-in RPS, concurrency, per-plan burst allowance and Retry-After guarantee not published.

facts.label: Event coverage and plan
facts.value: Enterprise includes application/organization event logs; source enumerates registrations, sign-ins, magic links, credential/alias changes, key/admin and configuration activity.

facts.label: Log retrieval and retention mechanics
facts.value: Enterprise-gated GET events uses page number, default 100 results and maximum 1,000; source daily worker deletes events older than feature-configured retention days.

facts.label: Hosted log retention/streaming fees
facts.value: Actual Enterprise retention days, Free/Pro diagnostic retention, event export/streaming SLA and additional log fees not published.

facts.label: Credential extraction
facts.value: credentials/list returns stored public-key credential data; source response includes PublicKey, UserHandle/UserId, descriptor, signature counter, RP ID/origin and device/backup metadata.

facts.label: User listing/export cap
facts.value: Source users/list builds user summaries with credentials/last use/aliases; storage takes up to 1,000 credential groups and 1,000 alias groups, without using its lastUserId argument.

facts.label: Alias return discrepancy
facts.value: API guide says aliases are never returned; current UserSummary/storage code returns available plaintext aliases in user summaries.

facts.label: Bulk/support export and exit guarantees
facts.value: Hosted bulk export tooling, export fee, full backup retrieval, relationship export and post-termination access window not established.

facts.label: Bring existing account IDs
facts.value: Registration accepts app-generated userId (WebAuthn user handle, max 64 bytes) and display username, so passkeys can be added to existing application accounts.

facts.label: Credential/secret import
facts.value: Public passkey credential import, supported password-hash/TOTP import, bulk user migration API and preserved-credential migration-in contract not found.

facts.label: Historical beta migration
facts.value: GA release notes say beta-to-GA data migration was unavailable, with new signup/keys/URLs/frontend/backend changes required.

facts.label: Deleting a credential/user
facts.value: credentials/delete removes one credential; users/delete requires the private secret and deletes that userId’s credential and alias records in the published storage implementation.

facts.label: App/account deletion controls
facts.value: Source exposes management-key app mark-delete/cancel-delete/delete operations; docs say marking an app for deletion locks its API keys.

facts.label: Retention and backup erasure
facts.value: Passwordless.dev-specific personal-data, backup, deleted-user and hosted app purge periods not published in checked policy/docs/source.

facts.label: Hosted data location
facts.value: Exact Passwordless.dev hosted credential/database/log regions, region selection, backup-region pairs and residency price not established.

facts.label: Self-host data location
facts.value: Experimental self-host operator chooses its own container/database storage location and external communication providers.

facts.label: Product-specific audit claim
facts.value: GA announcement dated 2023-05-17 says Passwordless.dev completed a Cure53 penetration/source-code audit covering servers, infrastructure and web apps.

facts.label: Parent privacy and subprocessors
facts.value: Bitwarden publishes a privacy policy and subprocessor table, naming hosting, email, payment and monitoring providers and locations.

facts.label: Processing and assurance scope gaps
facts.value: Product-specific public DPA/transfer annex, definitive subprocessor subset, SOC/ISO/FIDO certification scope/period and plan entitlement not established.

facts.label: Credential privacy controls
facts.value: UserId should contain no PII; username/display name used by browser and not stored by the service as those profile fields; aliases hashed by default; credentials retain RP/origin/device/country metadata.

facts.label: Name, aliases and owner
facts.value: Bitwarden Passwordless.dev; formerly Passwordless.dev; acquired by Bitwarden on 2023-01-18. passwordless.dev currently leads to the Bitwarden product page.

facts.label: Acquisition and GA history
facts.value: Acquisition announced 2023-01-18; hosted general availability announced 2023-05-17; original beta-to-GA required new keys/API URLs and re-enrollment rather than data migration.

facts.label: Current lifecycle evidence
facts.value: Current Free/Pro/Enterprise offer advertised; server repo not archived; latest fetched stable server release 1.0.102 dated 2026-09-22.

facts.label: Server repository license
facts.value: Root LICENSE.txt is Bitwarden License Agreement v1, 2020-09-04; commercial-module grant allows only internal development/testing in non-production, with resale/distribution/competing-service restrictions.

facts.label: Open-source wording disagreement
facts.value: Product/docs describe the code as open source/all code open source, but the checked server root uses the restrictive Bitwarden license; client components have different licenses.

facts.label: Checked JavaScript/Node SDK licenses
facts.value: JavaScript browser client and Node.js backend SDK have Apache-2.0 license files.

facts.label: Public status scope
facts.value: Bitwarden publishes status.bitwarden.com, listing parent US/EU cloud/identity/API/vault and client components; Passwordless.dev is not separately named in the checked listing.

facts.label: Availability SLA details
facts.value: Pro advertises a dedicated SLA; numeric uptime target, measurement/exclusions, credits and claim deadline not published in checked product/docs/general terms.

facts.label: Server maintenance evidence
facts.value: Repository not archived; latest fetched stable release 1.0.102 published 2026-09-22T20:05:38Z; preceding 1.0.101 is marked prerelease.

facts.label: Checked SDK and support lifecycle
facts.value: Node SDK package version 1.0.2; server security policy accepts vulnerability reports through Bitwarden HackerOne/contact; fixed supported-major/EOL/patch-deadline matrix not found.

facts.label: Support routes and plan distinction
facts.value: Free includes support/docs; Pro prioritized support; Enterprise advanced support. Server README gives support@passwordless.dev.

facts.label: Support hours and response SLA
facts.value: Numeric initial-response/resolution targets, coverage hours and Enterprise escalation schedule not published.
